correctness.rationale: For each selected old-vertex set A, all choices of selected edge vertices are classified by independent original-vertex capacity-one constraints, establishing the complete polynomial. Maximality is proved by testing insertions of every type of missing vertex; the sole nonautomatic boundary b=2 imposes surjectivity onto the two omitted originals, explaining inclusion-exclusion. Exact b=0,1,2,>=3 enumeration and convex extremal comparison cover n>=3 including exceptional cases. The adjacency-based verifier exhaustively confirmed 2,131,008 subsets, but finite tests are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This natural full-subdivision incidence family links maximal dissociation sets with minimal 3-path vertex covers, whose full inclusion-maximal cardinality distribution is not determined by the ordinary dissociation number. The exact facet polynomial, surjectivity obstruction for two omitted originals, unique extremal configurations for n>=5 and quadratically increasing size gap provide structural and enumerative information with genuine mathematical motivation.
